'));background-position:center 47%;background-size:cover;filter:contrast(1.08) saturate(.78) brightness(.88);animation:stage-drift 28s ease-in-out infinite alternate;will-change:transform}
.chapter-stage canvas{display:none}
.chapter-stage .stage-shade{z-index:-2;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#080c0ff7 0%,#0b1214c4 33%,#0b141556 60%,#07101112 100%),linear-gradient(0deg,#050909f7 0%,transparent 42%,#07100f66 100%)}
.chapter-stage.grain:after{z-index:-1;opacity:.16}
.stage-content{padding:clamp(35px,5vw,98px) clamp(32px,7.7vw,155px);padding-bottom:clamp(120px,16vh,180px)}
.stage-top{align-items:center}.stage-framecode{color:#e8d6b799;font-family:var(--mono);letter-spacing:.23em;font-size:10px}.stage-top .eyebrow{margin-left:auto;margin-right:20px}.frame-badge{color:#f3dfbd;background:#0004;border-color:#fbdfac69}
.stage-main{max-width:min(950px,68%)}.stage-heading{font-size:clamp(68px,7.1vw,128px);line-height:.92;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.071em;max-width:900px;margin:23px 0}.stage-deck{max-width:640px;font-size:clamp(17px,1.3vw,21px);line-height:1.75;text-shadow:0 2px 14px #000b}.stage-act{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.25em}
.stage-bottom{gap:15px}.scene-explore{border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #e6c796;background:transparent;color:#efcd9a;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.17em;font-size:10px;padding:12px 0;text-align:left;pointer-events:auto}.scene-explore:hover{color:white}.stage-controls{margin-left:auto;gap:10px}.round-arrow{width:57px;height:57px;font-size:23px;background:#101a1c8e;border-color:#d7c5a28a;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.side-panel{position:absolute;bottom:26px;left:clamp(32px,7.7vw,155px);right:clamp(32px,7.7vw,155px);border:1px solid #e6d6bb4a;background:#101719b3;backdrop-filter:blur(25px);display:block;padding:15px 17px;min-height:0;box-shadow:0 13px 60px #0004}
.side-panel .side-title,.side-panel .rail-quote{display:none}.act-rail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px}.act-btn{min-width:0;min-height:80px;border:1px solid transparent;padding:12px 8px;justify-content:start;gap:9px;background:transparent}.act-btn:hover{background:#ffffff0a}.act-btn.active{background:#d4ab7330;border-color:#d9b57c79}.act-num{font-size:23px}.act-name{font-size:12px;white-space:normal}.act-date{font-size:9px}
@keyframes stage-drift{from{transform:scale(1.04) translate3d(0,0,0)}to{transform:scale(1.11) translate3d(-1.2%,0,0)}}@keyframes chapter-reveal{from{opacity:.18;filter:blur(11px);transform:scale(1.08)}to{opacity:1;filter:blur(0);transform:scale(1)}}
.chapter-stage.scene-enter .stage-art{animation:chapter-reveal .8s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.2,1) both,stage-drift 28s .8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.chapter-stage.scene-enter .stage-main{animation:copy-in .68s .15s both}@keyframes copy-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(23px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.chapter-under{padding-top:90px;padding-bottom:95px}.chapter-text-grid{gap:8vw}.chapter-body h2{font-size:clamp(45px,4vw,74px);font-family:var(--serif);line-height:1.05}.chapter-body p{line-height:1.95;color:#d9d0c4;font-size:16px}.section-mini{letter-spacing:.23em}.contextcard{border:1px solid #bc9a6e70;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#182026,#121618)}.contextcard h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(30px,3vw,48px);font-weight:400}
.timeline-section{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#171d1d,#101718,#080d11);border-block:1px solid #e7c8982d}.timeline-top h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(44px,5vw,81px);font-weight:400}.time-surface{border:1px solid #d7b78344;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#2730317a,#101416);box-shadow:0 20px 75px #0005;padding:clamp(21px,3vw,45px)}.moment{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0c1618aa,#0e1718);border:1px solid #bca07836}.moment-year{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(70px,8vw,130px);font-style:italic;color:#ecc594}.moment-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px}.moment-actions .pillbtn{font-size:10px;border-color:#d9b78280;background:#cf9b6332;color:#f1d9b5;white-space:normal;text-align:left}
.lab-hero,.connections-hero,.notes-hero{padding-top:65px;padding-bottom:42px}.bigtitle{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(64px,6.4vw,118px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.065em}.bigtitle i{color:#d9ad76}.lead{color:#c7c4bb;line-height:1.9}
.lab-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.7fr) minmax(305px,.76fr);gap:18px}.lab-screen{min-height:620px;border:1px solid #d8bd8e50;background:#16262a;box-shadow:0 24px 80px #0009}.lab-screen .screen-vig{background:linear-gradient(0deg,#030608bd,transparent 38%),linear-gradient(180deg,#090a0ca6,transparent 24%);pointer-events:none}.lab-screen:after{opacity:.16}.lab-screen-top{padding:25px}.lab-subtitle{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:19px;text-shadow:0 2px 16px black}.director-monitor-tag{position:absolute;right:30px;bottom:25px;font:9px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.16em;color:#e7d6b0a8;z-index:3}.director-monitor-tag span{color:#db5d51}.lab-controls{border:1px solid #e3c79832;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#181e21,#111619);padding:clamp(22px,2vw,38px)}.control-set{border-color:#ffffff17}.control-set h3{color:#ebc695;letter-spacing:.18em}.seg button{min-height:47px}.seg button.selected{background:#caa06a32;color:#f5dcb3;border-color:#d2ad77}.lab-analysis{border:1px solid #ffffff19;background:#0c1113;margin-top:20px}.comparison-set{display:block}.compare-range{width:100%;accent-color:var(--gold);margin-top:13px;cursor:ew-resize}.compare-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:13px;color:#d3c1a6;font-size:11px}
.connections-hero,.notes-hero{max-width:900px}.network-canvas{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#42463c3d,transparent 48%),linear-gradient(145deg,#1b2226,#0c1215);border:1px solid #b9a07734}.connection-detail,.notepanel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1b2123,#121819);border:1px solid #a8957435}.notepanel h2{font-family:var(--serif)}.site-footer{background:#090c0f}
.projector{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:150;overflow:hidden;background:#06090b;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;isolation:isolate}
.projector-image{position:absolute;inset:-3%;z-index:-3;background:center/cover no-repeat;animation:projector-crawl 23s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.projector-vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#04090cf5,#071115d5 35%,#0b0f1280 65%,#07101336),linear-gradient(0deg,#060a0bed,transparent 36%,transparent 65%,#07090cb3)}
.projector:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,transparent 4px,#0000000d 5px);opacity:.5}
.projector-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:clamp(22px,3.7vw,60px) clamp(25px,5vw,90px);gap:20px;color:#e0c9a5;letter-spacing:.24em;font:10px var(--mono)}.projector-top button{color:#e9d7be;background:#0a0e0da9;border:1px solid #e4cfa878;padding:13px 19px;letter-spacing:.18em}
.projector-copy{padding:0 clamp(25px,8vw,155px);max-width:960px}.projector-year{font:italic clamp(130px,18vw,310px)/.9 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.105em;color:#f0c28a;text-shadow:0 10px 55px #0007}.projector-copy h2{font:normal clamp(32px,4vw,69px)/1.05 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:16px 0}.projector-copy p{font-size:clamp(14px,1.25vw,18px);line-height:1.9;color:#e4ded2;max-width:720px}.projector-copy a{color:#edbd82;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:10px}.projector-bottom{padding:22px clamp(25px,5vw,90px) clamp(22px,3vw,45px)}.projector-track{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:5px;margin-bottom:26px}.projector-track button{background:#ffffff39;border:0;height:5px;padding:0;transition:background .2s}.projector-track button[aria-current='true']{background:#e9bc7c}.projector-track button:hover{background:white}.projector-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:22px;font:12px var(--mono);color:#eacaa0}.projector-controls button{width:52px;height:52px;border:1px solid #e6cba67c;border-radius:50%;background:#0b1213a8;color:#fff;font-size:24px}.projector-controls button:disabled{opacity:.35}
@keyframes projector-crawl{to{transform:scale(1.1) translateX(-1.2%)}}
.shutter{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#050708;z-index:145;pointer-events:none;opacity:0}.shutter.play{animation:shutterflash .72s ease-in-out forwards}@keyframes shutterflash{0%{opacity:0}32%{opacity:.75}58%{opacity:.75}100%{opacity:0}}

/* ==================== ORIGIN 004 / THE CINEMATIC EDIT ==================== */
:root{--saffron:#e9b875;--ice:#a2bcc2;--char:#0b1013}
#portal:before{animation:hero-breathe 27s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#portal:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 76% 39%,#f6d49a1c 0%,transparent 35%),linear-gradient(118deg,transparent 30%,#f3c78b08 48%,transparent 60%);animation:portal-luminous 11s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes portal-luminous{0%{opacity:.3;transform:translateX(-2%)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateX(2%)}}
.portal-ctas .portal-edit{display:none}
#experience .section-nav .tabs{scrollbar-width:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto}
#experience .section-nav .tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
#experience .navtab{white-space:nowrap;flex:0 0 auto}
#editView{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#080c10 0%,#0b1115 52%,#090b0e 100%);min-height:100vh}
.edit-head{padding-top:clamp(52px,6vw,100px);padding-bottom:clamp(28px,3vw,55px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:end;gap:40px}
.edit-head .bigtitle{font-size:clamp(62px,7.6vw,126px);margin:14px 0 22px;letter-spacing:-.075em;line-height:.94}
.edit-head .bigtitle i{color:#edc38d}.edit-intro .lead{max-width:780px;color:#c9c8c4}
.edit-number{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;color:#af9370;letter-spacing:.3em;padding-bottom:16px;white-space:nowrap}
.edit-number small,.edit-number span{font:9px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.24em}.edit-number b{font:normal clamp(100px,15vw,230px)/.79 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.1em;color:#d2b487a6}
.edit-immersive{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.86fr) minmax(275px,.64fr);gap:14px}
.edit-theatre{border:1px solid #d7c7aa46;position:relative;aspect-ratio:1.78;min-height:490px;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,#284149,#091012 72%);box-shadow:0 20px 100px #000a;isolation:isolate}
#editCanvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.edit-theatre:before,.edit-theatre:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:7.5%;background:#050709;z-index:4;pointer-events:none}.edit-theatre:before{top:0}.edit-theatre:after{bottom:0}
.edit-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#02040588,transparent 27%,transparent 65%,#020405bf)}
.edit-vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 45%,transparent 24%,#0009 100%)}
.edit-hud{position:absolute;z-index:6;top:9%;left:4%;right:4%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:#ecd6b7;font:10px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.2em;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #000}
.edit-record-dot{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;background:#dd705b;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 10px #dd705b;margin-right:9px}
.edit-frame-caption{position:absolute;z-index:5;left:5%;right:5%;bottom:13%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;pointer-events:none;text-shadow:0 2px 15px #000}
.edit-frame-caption>span:first-child{color:#ecc493;font:10px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.22em}.edit-frame-caption strong{font:normal clamp(27px,3vw,59px)/1.09 var(--serif);max-width:600px;letter-spacing:-.04em}.edit-frame-caption>span:last-child{font-size:clamp(11px,.95vw,15px);color:#ece1cf}
.edit-bottomline{position:absolute;left:4%;right:4%;bottom:3.3%;z-index:6;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;color:#e3caa19e;font:9px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.2em}
.edit-playing-tag{position:absolute;right:4%;top:16%;z-index:6;border:1px solid #f3d5a55c;padding:10px 11px;color:#f0ddbc;background:#0a101288;font:9px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.14em;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.edit-progress-track{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:4px;z-index:9;background:#2d383b}.edit-progress-track>div{height:100%;width:0;background:#e4b475;transition:width .08s linear}
.edit-side{border:1px solid #e9d8be2d;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#171c1d,#0d1217);padding:clamp(22px,2.1vw,38px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:23px}
.edit-side-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}.edit-tech{font:9px var(--mono);color:#87999b;letter-spacing:.09em}.edit-play-head{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff1e;padding-bottom:24px}.edit-play-index{font:italic 62px/.9 var(--serif);color:#d7b781}.edit-play-head h2{font:normal clamp(26px,2vw,38px) var(--serif);margin:0 0 5px}.edit-play-head p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:#b6babc;margin:0}
.edit-primary{width:100%;border:0;background:#e8b777;color:#141617;font:800 11px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.17em;padding:20px 16px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:13px;align-items:center;transition:background .25s}.edit-primary:hover{background:#f7d19a}.edit-primary:focus-visible{outline-color:#faf4e6}
.edit-setting{border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff1b;padding-bottom:20px}.edit-setting-title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:13px;font:9px var(--mono);color:#c9b799;letter-spacing:.12em}.edit-setting-title span+span{color:#a1abb0}
.edit-choice-row{display:flex;gap:7px}.edit-choice-row button{border:1px solid #ffffff29;background:#161e22;color:#b9c1c3;padding:11px 14px;flex:1;font-size:11px}.edit-choice-row button.active{background:#eab97725;color:#f7d5a7;border-color:#d5b784ab}
.edit-mix-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;color:#e3ddd3;font-size:12px}.edit-mix-label output{font:11px var(--mono);color:#e8bc81}#editSoundSlider{width:100%;margin:18px 0 5px;accent-color:#e8b977}.edit-audio-note{color:#8e989b;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;margin:0}
.edit-side-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font:9px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.07em;color:#b8c0bd;margin-top:auto}.edit-led{width:7px;height:7px;background:#a5ccab;border-radius:50%;box-shad
